item.title: La Liga: Four Things We Learned In Spain's Matchday 20
item.description: Referee Gil Manzano: FC Barcelona lost 2-1 away to Real Sociedad on Sunday, allowing Real Madrid to close to within a point of the La Liga leader after a turbulent weekend that also raised fresh questions about the use of VAR.

item.title: Delhi Capitals vs Mumbai Indians, Match 13, WPL 2026, Who will win today DC-W vs MI-W match?
item.description: Delhi Capitals will take on Mumbai Indians women in the next game of the WPL 2026 on Tuesday.

item.title: Kostoulas's Stoppage Time Stunner Helps Brighton Hold Bournemouth
item.description: Charalampos Kostoulas: Charalampos Kostoulas scored a spectacular overhead kick in second-half stoppage time to salvage a point for Brighton & Hove Albion in a 1-1 draw with AFC Bournemouth.

item.title: Bangladesh Told to Play T20 World Cup Matches in India or Face Expulsion
item.description: Cricket’s governing body has warned Bangladesh to agree to play their T20 World Cup matches in India or risk being dropped from the tournament, amid security concerns, political tensions, and stalled talks with the ICC.

item.title: Aus Open: Defending Champ Keys Survives Oliynykova Scare To Reach Second Round
item.description: Ukrainian Oleksandra Oliynykova: Madison Keys survived an early scare against the unorthodox Ukrainian Oleksandra Oliynykova at Rod Laver Arena to launch her Australian Open title defence on Tuesday.

item.title: Alyssa Healy Retires as the Cricketer With a One-of-a-Kind Guinness Record
item.description: Alyssa Healy, one of cricket’s greatest, announces retirement after an illustrious career filled with World Cups, records, and honours. She remains unmatched for her one-of-a-kind Guinness World Record catch, a feat no other cricketer has attempted.

item.title: Aus Open: Musetti Receives First-round Walkover After Collignon Retires With Injury
item.description: The World No: World no. 5 Lorenzo Musetti of Italy advanced to the second round after his Belgian opponent Raphael Collignon retired due to injury.

item.title: NZ Add Kristian Clarke To Squad For Three T20s Against India
item.description: Sunrisers Eastern Cape: New Zealand have added young all-rounder Kristian Clarke to their squad for the first three games of their upcoming T20I series against India, starting on Wednesday in Nagpur, as seamer Adam Milne and experienced spinner Michael Bracewell are both battling injuries in the lead-up to the series.

item.title: Aus Open: Shelton Edges Past Humbert In Opening Round Thriller
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: World No. 8 Ben Shelton overcame a dangerous opening-round draw of the Australian Open at the Rod Laver Arena in Melbourne Park on Day 3 of the first Grand Slam of the year to defeat Ugo Humbert.

item.title: BCCI To Discuss Changes In India Men’s Central Contracts In Apex Council Meeting
item.description: BCCI Apex Council: The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) will discuss possible changes to the India men’s central contracts system at its next Apex Council meeting, as per proposals from the Ajit Agarkar-led selection committee.
